reasons.text: National Weather Service Winter Storm Warning for Weber County, until 11:00 a.m. Nov. 21.
Snow is in the Valley forecast for Saturday, Sunday, Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday.
Hard freeze: lows of 25° or colder on 6 nights, as cold as 14° Monday night.
